end.summary:
Practised the order: cell → tissue → organ → organ system → organism.
Explained that tissues are groups of similar cells and organs contain different tissues.
Discussed the heart as an organ and digestive system as an organ system.
Discussed Amoeba as a single-celled organism without tissues or organs.
The final teach-back of the full sequence was incomplete.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the levels of organisation using cell, tissue, heart, digestive system, and Amoeba examples. Yash explained the tissue–organ relationship clearly and correctly identified Amoeba as a single-celled organism. They continued to mix up whether the heart is an organ or an organ system, and this was not fully corrected by the end. At home, ask them to arrange five cards labelled cell, tissue, organ, organ system, and organism, then give one example for each.
